q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: SELECT (SELECT NUM AS NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) =1 ORDER BY COUNT(NUM) DESC, NUM DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS NUM

explanation: Q1 finds the maximum unique number, while Q2 finds the unique number with the highest count (which is always 1 for unique numbers) and if there are multiple such numbers, it returns the largest one.
counterexample_dsp: When there are multiple unique numbers, Q1 will return the maximum of these, whereas Q2 will return the largest of these unique numbers.
